His life, his work

KennethMacMillan

1929  –  1992

This site is the archive of the choreographer Kenneth MacMillan: ninety-one ballets made over forty years, with the essays, photographs and production records that surround them.

A new edition is in preparation and will be here shortly. In the meantime, enquiries are very welcome and are answered as usual.
